subject: POC kickoff — next steps & checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Katie Reynolds <katie.reynolds@acme-corp.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff — next steps & checklist

Hi Katie / Tom,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC rolling: 

1) Scope: validate inference latency and cost for your document summarization workload (target 95th pct latency < 350ms).
2) Success metrics: throughput at 50 reqs/min, avg token cost <= $0.002/token, and acceptable quality on the 5 sample prompts you shared.
3) POC plan: 2-week trial, sandbox environment + sample dataset, and one success review at the end.

Attached: POC-Checklist.pdf (short setup steps) and SOW-Draft.docx (for procurement review).

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm the internal stakeholders for infra/security + procurement so we can loop them into kickoff?
- Are you available for a 30-min kickoff next Tue (5/12) or Wed (5/13) to complete setup and handoff to our CS engineer?

If it helps I can open the sandbox and drop the quick-start instructions in a shared doc ahead of the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

--
Attachments: POC-Checklist.pdf, SOW-Draft.docx

I went ahead and held 5/13 10:00am PT on my calendar as tentative. If procurement needs a redline on the SOW, happy to accept and then route to our legal; we can also provide a short statement of work addendum to speed approval.

- Drop sandbox creds + quick-start in the shared Drive by EOD Monday.
- Loop in our CS engineer (Rishi) on the kickoff so we can handle onboarding and sampling.

If you prefer, I can run a short pre-kickoff with Tom to walk through network requirements (15 min).

Marissa
